about: A short label on something: a filter a person applied, the kind of thing a record is, or its state. A mark goes at either end, and a close trigger removes the tag.

effect.about: A halo around the tag, in the palette's solid at half opacity. `pulse` animates it and stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
effect.title: Effects

filters.about: Press a close trigger to remove a filter, and Reset to restore them. Each close trigger is its own button, with a tab stop and a name that includes the filter it removes.
filters.title: Removing a tag

marks.about: A mark at the start names the kind of thing, and a mark at the end names a state. Both are sized in `em`, so they follow the label.
marks.title: Marks

overflow.about: A label longer than its container is cut with an ellipsis, and the close trigger stays visible. The whole label stays in the DOM, so a screen reader announces all of it.
overflow.title: A long label

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The looks are flat, so a tag does not change under the pointer. The close trigger hovers to a darker square, or to a tint of the label ink on a solid tag.
palette.title: Palettes and looks

radius.about: Every corner, from the theme's corner scale.
radius.title: Corners

size.about: Each size sets the height on the tag scale, the label one size smaller, and a padding and a gap from the gap scale. A plain tag, a tag with a mark and a removable tag have the same height at each size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Tag
